name: Pokémon Awakening
storyline:
In the secluded Waerfall Village, cradled by Angard’s misty peaks, ancient Idols slumber—relics of a forgotten era when gods and mortals clashed in the Holy War. Raised as apprentices to the wise Sage Addae, you and your brother share a bond deeper than blood: the D. Moon, a cryptic grimoire discovered between you as infants, its pages blank until now. When the tome pulses with eerie light near the northern waterfalls, it awakens, revealing cryptic visions of Angard’s fractured past and a divine call to action. With your Pokémon team and Pixi, a sharp-witted guardian fairy, you embark to unravel the grimoire’s ties to the Idols—and your own mysterious origins. Yet as whispers of chaos stir, a schism emerges: will you align with the Order of the Goddess to preserve balance, or embrace Chaos to shatter fate itself?

Your journey spans Angard’s untamed wilds and crumbling sanctums, where Local Legends—titanic Pokémon steeped in myth—guard secrets of the Holy War. Recruit Angels, Demons, and ancient Legendaries to your cause, while a class system lets you master roles like mystic summoner or shadowblade tactician. Forge bonds with allies through a Persona-like relationship system, where trust unlocks hidden quests and alters story outcomes. Time itself bends to your choices: pursue quests under dawn’s light or midnight’s veil, and confront world-shaking events that shift with the clock. But as the Idols’ power grows volatile, the grimoire’s final revelation looms: will you mend Angard’s scars with order, or rewrite its destiny in chaos? The D. Moon’s last page remains blank—your legacy will ink its end.
summary:
In the secluded Waerfall Village, ancient Idols guard divine secrets—and the enigmatic grimoire D. Moon, shared between you and your brother since infancy, has begun to awaken. Guided by Sage Addae and joined by your Pokémon team and Pixi, a spirited guardian fairy, you’ll explore Angard’s forgotten ruins and untamed wilds to unravel the grimoire’s ties to a looming Holy War. But as chaos threatens to shatter the world, a pivotal choice emerges: uphold order as the goddess’s champion, or embrace chaos to forge a new destiny.

Tailor your journey with a Class System that unlocks battle strategies, clash with towering Local Legends, and bond with allies through a relationship system that alters the story’s course. With time-based events, overworld encounters, and two stark endings, every decision weaves your legacy. Will Angard find peace—or burn in divine reckoning? The final page of D. Moon awaits your hand…
